symbolic_mapping: repetition of posture maps to passive engagement

alternative_interpretations: The scene may simply depict a stylized illustration of students in a lecture hall without symbolic intent.
limitations: No textual labels or contextual cues confirm institutional purpose; style alone cannot verify intent.
